title: prusik status ticks an exit artifact that advance would refuse
detail: phases.status marks an exit artifact present when the file exists. advance runs each artifact's validator (execution_evidence, brief_schema and the rest), so status can show every artifact ticked and advance still refuse. Reported in fb-5d7b7cae0f30 and left out of v0.238.7. The advance check cannot be reused as is: gate._evidence_unsatisfied appends ledger events on every call, so a read-only status would write to the ledger. Needs the check split from its ledger writes first.
